auth: Bearer token supplied out-of-band and never stored in source
principles: Chrome is the control plane, not the process executor
The authorized Runtime Agent owns Docker Engine access
Agent operations are allow-listed; arbitrary shell and arbitrary Docker arguments are forbidden
Every mutating request is authenticated and auditable
No Docker socket is exposed to arbitrary web origins
Native Messaging is optional, not a baseline dependency
Remote endpoints must be protected by TLS, VPN, private networking, or an equivalent trusted boundary
